newsitem.title: USA: Peoples Heritage to buy Maine insurer.
newsitem.headline: Peoples Heritage to buy Maine insurer.

text.p: Peoples Heritage Financial Group Inc said Monday it signed a binding letter of intent to buy privately-held Morse, Payson & Noyes Insurance for an undisclosed price.

Peoples Heritage Bank will operate the company, which is Maine's largest insurer with $125 million in policy premiums and 145 employees. It sells individual and commercial property and casualty insurance, and medical, life and disability insurance.
The companies will be looking to buy other insurance agencies, said the chief executives of Peoples and the insurer. The buy-out is subject to regulatory and certain corporate approvals.
